# Threat Model — portfolio.aplix.nl / portfolio-astro

## Overview

A personal developer portfolio built with **Astro 7** (static-site generator). Built via `bun run build` in a multi-stage Docker container using `oven/bun` → `nginx:alpine`. All pages are **fully prerendered** — zero server-side rendering, zero API routes, zero database connections at runtime. Served entirely as static files over HTTP (port 80, no HTTPS termination on the nginx container itself despite HSTS header).

The site has three data sources:
- Hardcoded data in `src/data/portfolio.ts` (projects, skills, experience, contact info, social links)
- Remote Ghost CMS content fetched **at build time** via `@tryghost/content-api` for `/blog`
- Contact form submissions routed to an external third-party mail relay (`formsubmit.co`)

## Trust Boundaries and Assumptions

### Attacker Model
- Network-level attacker who can reach `https://portfolio.aplix.nl`
- Can submit arbitrary HTTP requests (including the contact form POST)
- Cannot authenticate to any backend (none exists)

### Trust Invariants
1. **No runtime computation** — nginx serves pre-rendered HTML/CSS/JS/assets. No code execution occurs after build.
2. **Ghost Content API key is build-time only** — consumed via `astro:env/server`, never baked into client JS. `.prerender/` directory explicitly deleted post-build.
3. **Contact form POST is direct browser-to-formsubmit.co** — no intermediary server processing.

### Attacker-Reachable Surfaces
1. `/blog/[...slug]` — blog listing + individual posts. Post HTML is injected verbatim via `set:html`.
2. `/contact` — contact form POSTs to `https://formsubmit.co/heroldtamko39@gmail.com`
3. Static assets under `/_astro/`, `/favicon.*`, images, etc.
4. Sitemap, robots.txt, canonical URLs
5. `<meta name="generator">` reveals Astro version

### NOT Attacker-Reachable
- Build-time secrets (GHOST_URL, CONTENT_API_KEY) — scoped to server context per Astro config
- Server-side `ghost.ts` module — never shipped to client
- Vendored shadcn-vue components in `src/components/ui/` — imported but unused by any page

## Attack Surface and Attacker Stories

### Surface 1: Ghost CMS HTML Injection → Stored XSS
**Path:** Blog post HTML field → `set:html={Astro.props.post.html}` in `[...slug].astro`
**Risk:** If Ghost CMS account is compromised, an attacker injects malicious HTML/JS into blog post content. Since the rendered HTML is cached at build time, the XSS persists until the next rebuild. Impact: session hijacking of readers visiting the compromised blog post, phishing pivots via script injection.
**Mitigations present:** None — raw HTML is trusted blindly.
**Severity:** High (if Ghost is compromised); Low/Medium otherwise (depends on Ghost access controls)

### Surface 2: Contact Form → External Relay (FormSubmit.co)
**Path:** `POST https://formsubmit.co/heroldtamko39@gmail.com`
**Risk:** Spam abuse, mail bombing. `_captcha=false` relies solely on honeypot field (`_honey`) which clients can trivially bypass. No rate limiting, no CAPTCHA, no reCAPTCHA, no honeypot validation on server side (there is no server side). The recipient email address is visible in the form action URL.
**Mitigations:** Honeypot field present but easily bypassed. No CSP header blocking form submission origins.
**Severity:** Medium (spam/reputation impact)

### Surface 3: Information Disclosure
**Path:** Multiple surfaces
- `<meta name="generator" content={Astro.generator}>` → reveals exact Astro version
- `src/data/portfolio.ts` → personal email, phone number, location hardcoded
- Open Graph image URL points to external storage (`storage.applix.fr`)
- GitHub username `STIFLEUR390` disclosed
- Social links include `mailto:` URI exposing personal email
**Mitigations:** None for most of these.
**Severity:** Low (reconnaissance aid)

### Surface 4: Dark Mode localStorage Script
**Path:** Inline script in BaseLayout.astro reads `localStorage.getItem('theme')`
**Risk:** Reads theme preference from localStorage. Does NOT write or inject user-controlled data into DOM. Uses `document.documentElement.classList.add('dark')` based on stored value or `prefers-color-scheme`. 
**Severity:** Low/None — reading localStorage and applying a CSS class based on it is not an XSS vector.

### Surface 5: nginx Configuration
**Path:** `docker/nginx.conf`
**Observations:** Security headers present (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options DENY, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy). Prerender directory removal confirmed. No directory listing enabled. HTTP-only serving (despite HSTS header sent — no actual TLS termination documented).
**Severity:** Informational — HSTS is set but site may not be behind a reverse proxy handling TLS.

## Severity Calibration

| Finding Class | Expected Severity | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Stored XSS via Ghost | High | Direct compromise path, affects all blog readers |
| Contact form spam | Medium | Abuse of external relay, reputation damage |
| Information disclosure | Low | Public info, aids targeting |
| Dark mode localStorage | None | Not exploitable |
| nginx missing TLS termination | Medium | HSTS header present but ineffective without HTTPS |
